video_goal: Demonstrate the precise placement and activation of Scolecite crystals on a Flower of Life grid.
required_subjects_and_props: Flower of Life grid cloth or board, large Scolecite cluster (center stone), small tumbled Scolecite crystals, needle-like Scolecite crystals, clear quartz activation wand.

outline_steps.visual_action: Hands unroll a dark cloth featuring a gold-printed Flower of Life sacred geometry pattern onto a flat wooden table.
Fingers place a large, white, striated Scolecite cluster directly onto the exact center point of the Flower of Life pattern.
Hands scoop up a handful of smaller, tumbled white Scolecite crystals from a small wooden bowl resting next to the grid.
A thumb and index finger place a single tumbled Scolecite crystal precisely on the top intersection of the inner circle of the Flower of Life.
Hands rapidly place five more tumbled Scolecite crystals on the remaining five intersections of the inner circle, forming a hexagon around the center.
Fingers pick up a slender, needle-like Scolecite crystal and position it on an outer petal intersection, pointing the tip outward away from the center.
Hands place five more needle-like Scolecite crystals on the remaining outer petal intersections, all pointing outward in a symmetrical starburst pattern.
Index fingers gently nudge two of the outer needle-like Scolecite crystals to perfectly align them with the printed gold lines of the grid.
The right hand reaches off the grid and picks up a clear quartz crystal activation wand by its base.
The pointed tip of the quartz wand is held hovering just a millimeter above the center Scolecite cluster.
The wand traces an invisible line through the air from the center cluster to the top inner Scolecite crystal, then extends the line to the top outer Scolecite crystal.
The wand continues tracing in a clockwise circular motion, hovering over each outer Scolecite crystal and drawing invisible lines back to the center cluster.
Hands pull the wand away and rest it beside the cloth, leaving the fully assembled Flower of Life Scolecite crystal grid resting symmetrically on the table.
